evidence_boundary: SW2-22 covers content-addressed producer identity for vendored consumer toolchains, enriches it with exact Git provenance when verifiable Git metadata is available, and provides deterministic source-side upgrade planning/apply. It does not add remote auto-update, package-manager infrastructure, release publication, GitHub rulesets, or permission to rewrite Owner semantic authority.

requirements.requirement: Consumer toolchain locks bind vendored bytes to an exact source-content digest. Verifiable Git checkouts additionally record repository, exact source SHA, release identity, and identity_source=GIT+CONTENT; copied/package sources without Git metadata use identity_source=CONTENT and explicitly mark Git-only fields NOT_PROVEN. Missing, malformed, mismatched, or legacy hint-only identity fails closed.
A source-side read-only upgrade check produces a deterministic machine-readable plan and reports whether upgrade is required without mutating the consumer.
Upgrade apply mutates only toolchain-owned surfaces, preserves Owner semantic authority, and is idempotent for an already-current consumer.
Legacy v2.1, STANDARD, STRICT, tamper, Ubuntu/Windows, and pinned max-grounding consumer paths retain governance parity under the new provenance/upgrade contract.
Exact final candidate and post-merge main pass the complete six-context permanent Governance CI matrix.
